headline_marked: 8 [[killed in landslide at Rohingya camp]] in Cox's Bazar
headline: 8 killed in landslide at Rohingya camp in Cox's Bazar
summary: Five people were rescued alive from the debris after a landslide struck the refugee camp.
details: A landslide in a Rohingya refugee camp in Cox's Bazar has left eight people dead. The disaster occurred as the area experienced heavy rainfall, causing the hillside to collapse onto shelters.
Rescue operations were launched immediately following the collapse. Five individuals were successfully rescued alive from under the debris and are receiving medical attention.
The incident highlights the ongoing vulnerability of the refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, where precarious shelter conditions and hilly terrain make them prone to landslides during the monsoon season.
Local authorities and rescue teams continue to monitor the area to ensure no one else remains trapped under the soil.
caption:

Local authorities and rescue teams continue to monitor the area to ensure no one else remains trapped under the soil.

headline: Tragedy in South Africa: Bangladeshi businessman shot dead
summary: A Bangladeshi national working as a businessman in South Africa has been killed in a shooting incident.
details: A Bangladeshi businessman has been shot dead in South Africa. The incident has caused shock and grief among the Bangladeshi community in the region.
While the reports confirm the killing, further details regarding the motive behind the shooting or the identity of the perpetrators are still awaited.
Local authorities are expected to investigate the circumstances surrounding the attack to determine the cause of the death.
